# VelthineGlow

> VelthineGlow is a Pakistani skincare brand (Radiant Beauty) that sells two face serums online with Cash on Delivery all over Pakistan: Extra-C Vitamin C Serum and Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum.

## Products

- **Extra-C Vitamin C Serum (30 ml) — Rs 1,990.** 5% stabilised Vitamin C with Collagen and Centella. Dermatologist tested. For glowing skin, dull skin, uneven skin tone and fine lines. Light and fast-absorbing, suitable for oily skin. Use 3–4 drops in the morning, followed by sunscreen.
- **Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum (30 ml) — Rs 1,990.** 10% Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), 1% Zinc PCA, Alpha Arbutin, Hyaluronic Acid and Panthenol (Vitamin B5). For oily skin, open pores, dark spots, post-blemish marks and uneven skin tone. Use 3–4 drops at night.
- **Glow Duo — Rs 3,490 (save Rs 490).** Both serums together: Vitamin C in the morning, Niacinamide at night. Free delivery.

## Key facts

- Do not apply Vitamin C and Niacinamide at the same time; use Vitamin C in the morning and Niacinamide at night.
- For all skin types. Light and fast-absorbing. Patch test first on very sensitive skin.
- Delivery: 2–3 working days in big cities, 3–5 working days elsewhere in Pakistan. Free delivery on every order.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery. Orders are confirmed on call or WhatsApp.
- Orders and questions: WhatsApp +92 347 2616688.
- Based in Karachi, Pakistan. Delivers all over Pakistan.
